title: Certifying Nonlocal Spin Quantum Entanglement from Local Tunneling Spectra
summary: Quantum entanglement is intrinsically nonlocal, whereas tunneling spectroscopy measures one site at a time. We show that this apparent mismatch can be overcome: local tunneling spectra can certify spin entanglement without coherent control or absolute intensity calibration. An exact spin sum rule turns the high-bias conductance into an internal normalization, allowing the inelastic spin-flip weight to place a lower bound on the local quantum Fisher information.
